 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Read the two intersecting diagonals and arrange their outer and
    # inner cells into a 3x3 square around their shared center.
    n = len(grid)
    mid = n // 2
    main = [grid[i][i] for i in range(n)]
    anti = [grid[i][n - 1 - i] for i in range(n)]
    return [
        [main[0], main[1], anti[0]],
        [anti[1], grid[mid][mid], anti[-2]],
        [anti[-1], main[-2], main[-1]],
    ]
"
}
